'''Buzzbeak''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Buzzbeak]] at 6 bronze stars.

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Typically sings alone, but quickly harmonizes with other Tatari for a synchronized melody."

Sparkeet is a purple rarity Tatari.

== Appearance ==
Sparkeet is a toucan-like Tatari. It has a dark blue body with a white head and blue eyes. The shape of its mouth resembles a lighting bolt symbol.

Sparkeet's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its orange-yellow beak into magenta-pink.

== Evolution trial ==
Sparkeet's evolution trials unlock once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Buzzbeak]] you need to complete the following task:

* Feed Sparkeet Bolt Pudding x10

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Sparkeet holds the same power as two AA batteries, so turn on power-saving mode for long Zobo fights."
